root.name: METADATA
root.description: Root directory for all organized investigation metadata

subdirectories.name: Active Investigations
subdirectories.description: Organized by investigation_id, contains subdirectories for each investigation

subdirectories.name: Source Materials
subdirectories.description: Organized by source type: web, documents, media, databases

subdirectories.name: Extracted Artifacts
subdirectories.description: Screenshots, PDFs, parsed data, structured extracts from sources

subdirectories.name: Taxonomy Patterns
subdirectories.description: Learned patterns from investigation contexts for auto-organization

subdirectories.name: Indexed Metadata
subdirectories.description: Quick-access index files and search indices

routing_rules.name: Investigation Context Routing
routing_rules.description: Route files based on investigation_id and context_type
routing_rules.condition: Has investigation_id and context_type in metadata

routing_rules.name: Source Type Detection
routing_rules.description: Route based on detected source type
routing_rules.condition: Has source_type detected from content or filename

routing_rules.name: Content Analysis Routing
routing_rules.description: Route based on content analysis and learned patterns
routing_rules.condition: Content can be analyzed for taxonomy placement

routing_rules.name: Fallback Generic Routing
routing_rules.description: Default routing when other rules don't apply
